providers.name: Gmail
providers.authHint: App Password of a Google account with 2-Step Verification, or an OAuth 2.0 access token
providers.notes: SMTP also accepts STARTTLS on port 587. Folders live under the [Gmail] namespace.

providers.name: Outlook.com
providers.authHint: OAuth 2.0 access token; Outlook.com no longer accepts passwords for IMAP, POP3 and SMTP

providers.name: Microsoft 365
providers.authHint: OAuth 2.0 access token; a tenant may still allow a password for SMTP submission only
providers.notes: Work or school accounts; tenant policy may disable IMAP, POP3 or SMTP AUTH entirely.

providers.name: QQ Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code generated in the QQ Mail settings, not the account password
providers.notes: Server-side SEARCH with non-ASCII text is unreliable; the plugin falls back to client-side filtering. IMAP IDLE is accepted but the server pushes nothing while a client idles (verified 2026-09-19: no untagged response within 10 minutes of a delivery, after SELECT or EXAMINE), so watches poll unless mode 'idle' is asked for.

providers.name: 163 Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the 163 Mail settings (POP3/SMTP/IMAP page), not the account password
providers.notes: The IMAP server answers Unsafe Login to SELECT and EXAMINE on every connection that has not sent the ID command; the plugin identifies each connection it opens. The server keeps a copy of every message sent through SMTP in the sent folder (it appears with a delay of up to a few minutes), and SEARCH by SUBJECT or FROM answers OK without hits for just-delivered mail. The IMAP server has no IDLE (the command answers BAD), so watches poll.

providers.name: 126 Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the 126 Mail settings (POP3/SMTP/IMAP page), not the account password
providers.notes: Same servers policy as 163 Mail: every IMAP connection has to send the ID command before SELECT or EXAMINE; the plugin identifies each connection it opens. The server keeps a copy of every message sent through SMTP in the sent folder (verified with a real account), and SEARCH by SUBJECT or FROM answers OK without hits for just-delivered mail. The IMAP server has no IDLE (the command answers BAD), so watches poll.

providers.name: Yahoo Mail
providers.authHint: App password generated in the Yahoo account security settings
providers.notes: SMTP also accepts STARTTLS on port 587. Unverified against a real account (none is available to the project): autoSavesSent and the sent folder follow Yahoo's public documentation.

providers.name: Sina Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the Sina Mail client settings
providers.notes: The server does not keep a copy of mail sent through SMTP (the plugin appends one to the sent folder), and it answers NO to every IMAP CREATE: folders can only be made in the web UI, so createFolder fails with SERVER_ERROR. IMAP IDLE is accepted but nothing is pushed and the server closes the connection after 60 s of idling (verified 2026-09-19), so watches poll.

providers.name: Aliyun Mail
providers.authHint: Account password of a personal Aliyun Mail account
providers.notes: Personal edition. Unverified against a real account (none is available to the project): the server-side sent copy is unconfirmed, so autoSavesSent stays false and no sent folder is named.
